document_templates.parsed_html:
Axxel Technologies Ltd.

Appointment Order
Date: {{issue_date}}
Ref: AXL/HR/{{year}}/{{reference_number}}
To,
{{candidate_name}}
{{candidate_address}}
{{candidate_city}}, {{candidate_state}} - {{candidate_zip}}
Dear {{candidate_name}},

With reference to your application and subsequent interviews you had with us, we are pleased to appoint you as {{designation}} in {{department}} department at Axxel Technologies Ltd.

Your appointment is subject to the following terms and conditions:

  1. Date of Joining: Your appointment will be effective from your date of joining, which shall not be later than {{joining_date}}.
  2. Compensation: Your total annual Compensation Package (CTC) will be ₹{{annual_ctc}}. The detailed breakdown of your compensation is attached in Annexure A.
  3. Probation: You will be on probation for a period of {{probation_period_months}} months from your date of joining. Upon satisfactory completion of your probation, your employment will be confirmed in writing.
  4. Posting & Transfer: Your initial posting will be at our {{location}} office. However, your services are liable to be transferred to any of the company's offices, departments, or subsidiaries anywhere in India or abroad.
  5. Notice Period: During probation, either party may terminate this agreement by giving 15 days' notice. Post confirmation, the notice period will be {{notice_period_days}} days on either side.

Please sign and return the duplicate copy of this letter as a token of your acceptance of the terms and conditions mentioned above.

We welcome you to the Axxel family and wish you a long and mutually beneficial association with us.

Yours faithfully,
For Axxel Technologies Ltd.

{{hr_manager_name}}
Human Resources Head
Accepted By:
{{candidate_name}}
Date: ________________
